title: Tesla’s Cybercab has been deployed, and it’s already under investigation
summary: But the vehicle is already under investigation by the US federal government, which is probing whether it meets federal safety standards. Tesla, however, has said it doesn’t need an exemption because its vehicles comply with all existing safety standards.
